line: Three dozen lawmakers tell Sec. Mullin that Nonprofit Security Grant Program rules dissuading applicants

item.title: Three dozen lawmakers tell Sec. Mullin that Nonprofit Security Grant Program rules dissuading applicants

item.title: 83 years later, Yad Vashem honors Dutch woman who saved Jewish baby during Holocaust
item.summary: Jacqueline Meents-Lenstra hid Efraim Kochba as her own son in Nazi-occupied Holland after his Jewish parents entrusted the infant to her care.
